## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, the final change and any limitations.

## Validation

List the Debug configure/build/offline CTest commands and results. Explain failures or checks that could not run.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Relevant behavior is tested with offline, synthetic fixtures.
- [ ] `/W4 /WX` remains enabled and documentation matches the change.
- [ ] No generated binaries, downloaded media, user data, secrets or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Any new artwork/fixture has documented provenance and redistribution permission.
- [ ] The diff is focused and `git diff --check` passes.
